name: clash-of-clans-dashboard
description: Lokal laufendes Clash of Clans Dashboard: Live-Daten, manueller Bau-Tracker und Angriffsstrategie-Berater

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
